notes: Community: the 130,000-dose donation (110,000 to Uganda via Africa CDC, 20,000 to UNICEF for Liberia) is in-kind product donation during an outbreak, not an education or mentoring program. The Career Accelerator is a pilot with five participants, continued through Q2 2027. The Diversity & Inclusion policy and the gender and age statistics are policy and demographic disclosures only, so they add nothing above E2. Clinical partnerships with academia and the Serum Institute of India license are R&D and commercial arrangements, not community or cross-cultural programs. Smallpox vaccine supply 'for defense purposes' is a vaccine, not weapons. The S1 table reports 6 discrimination/harassment incidents raised through internal channels, with no fines or outside findings.
